Preserve current known PCM/IEEE-float, complete extensible GUID and AIFF-C integer/float code meanings and current Compression names. proposedBellaRules.navigation: Shared small checked chunk walker with explicit endian/form cases, safe extents/count arithmetic and padding. Follow chunk chain beyond sound data, not fixed front-header or first-data stop. Read required fmt/COMM prefixes/extensions, ds64 size facts/table, SSND offset/blockSize; leave sound samples on disk.
proposedBellaRules.optionalMetadata: Locate safely, read only a specific bext/iXML/umid/minf/fact/other value when a retained field is established to require it. Skip unneeded opaque/XML/ADM/tag/private bodies; no broad metadata whitelist copies, new XML framework or permanent raw chunk catalogue.

proposedBellaRules.FVER: Accept evidenced Avid AIFC layout without FVER, do not invent recorded version. If present read supported bounded consistent version; explicit unknown revision is not known, malformed/conflicting required version facts withhold dependent native interpretation. Independent OMF/database/filesystem facts remain. Proposed Bella boundary, not native enforcement claim.
proposedBellaRules.resources: One audio component/shared ordinary format helpers across native audio and OMF/MDB summaries; C++17/Qt6.5.3 scoped resources, compact owned facts and necessary temporary sizes/OMF locations, release after job. No per-chunk class/parser or decompressor.
proposedBellaRules.later: Useful native identity/editorial extensions, exact counts/rates/depth/clock/numbering and local failure/duplicate handling follow only for real native gaps. Final priority/opening/scheduling remains at end.
proposedBellaRules.limits: OldScanner already skips audio samples. Reduced opaque metadata reading/records is planned, unmeasured. Only two physical RIFF/AIFC tone layouts observed, no RF64/BW64/plainAIFF/float corpus or runtime/app/parser/test/build execution.

findings.fact: WAVEDescriptor::GetMetaData calls ReadWAVEMetaData. The latter reads an8byte chunk header, accepts only RIFF or RF64 at that entry, sets RF64 state for RF64, then ReadFormChunk requires WAVE. Thus this reviewed native descriptor-reader route has explicit RIFF/WAVE and RF64/WAVE capability; BW64 or RIFX is not admitted at this entry. That does not prove every import/AMA/plugin path rejects them.

Concrete branches consume fmt , data, ds64, bext, iXML, omfi, minf, umid and waveform overview ovwf chunks. Bext is passed to ReadBextChunk and its fields published to audio metadata; iXML is passed to ReadIxmlChunk, then an in-stream reference and presence flag are stored. There is no axml, ID3 or LIST semantic branch in this selected dispatcher; they reach the unknown-chunk skip path here. That is a local bound, not universal absence in the application.

ReadDS64Chunk combines low/high32bit words into64bit RIFF size, data size and samplecount storage. It reads ds64TableSize when enough bytes remain, then skips remaining bytes. This body does not resolve arbitrary additional ds64 table entries. The caller updates its form-end bound after ds64 and uses stored64bit data size when data size is0xffffffff and ds64 was seen. Do not claim complete all-RF64-table or any-large-file workflow parity.

findings.evidence: fresh chunk-header readers plus reused metadata loops
findings.fact: Both selected readers obtain8byte chunk headers and dispatch by IDs, rather than assuming fmt/COMM is at a fixed offset. Native partial/truncated behavior is not Bella bounds policy.

"""Curate the bounded native audio layout review; never read audio samples."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')
CACHE, VERIFIED, MISSING = {}, {}, []


def sha(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if str(p) not in CACHE:
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with p.open('rb') as stream:
            for b in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024*1024), b''):
                h.update(b)
        CACHE[str(p)] = h.hexdigest()
    return CACHE[str(p)]


def record(path):
    p = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p)}


def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'), ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                p = Path(value[pk])
                if not p.is_absolute(): p = ROOT/p
                if not p.is_file():
                    MISSING.append({'path': str(p), 'context': context, 'expectedSha256': value[hk]})
                else:
                    assert sha(p) == value[hk], (context, str(p))
                    VERIFIED[str(p)] = record(p)
        for k, v in value.items(): walk(v, context+'/'+str(k))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(value): walk(v, context+'/'+str(i))
